selection_purpose: Authorized data-use feasibility experiment; not proof that N is artistically superior to B.

deltas.before: Her front knee bends over a planted court shoe, her rear leg extends behind with the forefoot on the floor, and her free arm opens behind her for balance.
deltas.after: Her racket-side foot is the forward planted support toward the net, its knee bent above the shoe; her lowered torso reaches on that same racket side, her rear leg stretches behind with the forefoot on the floor, and her free arm opens behind her for balance.
deltas.reason: Makes the existing forward support belong to the racket side, absent from baseline.
deltas.expected_pixel_target: Racket-owned hand and forward leg align on the same anatomical side, low torso, rear forefoot support and low net reach coexist.

deltas.before: The racket hand closes around the handle; its shaft leads to a thin oval string bed held below the descending shuttle, leaving a clear small gap between cork and strings at this pre-contact instant.
deltas.after: The racket hand closes around a wrapped handle. A single slender shaft continues from that handle to one closed oval rim enclosing a crossed string bed; this same racket head is held below one feathered shuttle, leaving a clear small gap between cork and strings at this pre-contact instant. The shuttle has a small rounded cork at its narrow end, separate feather stems joining that base and spreading outward, and broad feather tips opening into a conical crown at the opposite end, distinct from the cork.
deltas.reason: Existing racket gains closed rim, crossed strings and wrapped handle while preserving one shaft and owned grip; existing shuttle gains complete cork/stem/crown structure from U05.
deltas.expected_pixel_target: One closed rim around crossed strings, one continuous slender shaft to wrapped grip held by foreground player.

deltas.after: The shuttle has a small rounded cork at its narrow end, separate feather stems joining that base and spreading outward, and broad feather tips opening into a conical crown at the opposite end, distinct from the cork.
deltas.reason: Complete feathered variant parts are new to the prompt, rather than merely relabeling baseline badminton.
deltas.expected_pixel_target: Distinct narrow cork, attached and spreading stems, opposite broad open conical tips visible together at native scale.
